                                force had, however, preempted dialogue.Rasgotraasked that we keep in mind other side of
                                case: that Pakistan military had been moving forward in East
                                Pakistan and that there were threats and provocations.
Secretary saidUShad had serious
                                difficulty with idea that Pakistan is threatening India in east. We
                                want to do everything we can to bring war to conclusion. We are
                                greatly distressed at events. We have[Page 686]legitimate interest in area where we have
                                tried to be of assistance. The President is very disappointed since
                                as a result of his conference with Mrs.Gandhihe thought that resort to force could be
                                avoided. In our judgment even if India succeeded in getting what it
                                wanted situation would be worse than before.
